memorize.usageZh: 及物动词，后接名词：memorize words / a poem / dates。强调“记牢”，比 remember 更主动。名词 memory。

examples.sentence: I memorize three new words after dinner.
examples.trans: 我晚饭后记住三个新词。

examples.sentence: She tried to memorize the dialogue before class.
examples.trans: 她课前努力把对话记牢。

examples.sentence: To prepare for the exam, she needs to memorize all the important historical dates.
examples.trans: 为了备考，她需要记住所有重要的历史日期。

examples.sentence: Do not memorize a paragraph if you cannot explain it in your own words.
examples.trans: 如果你不能用自己的话解释，就不要死记一段文字。

examples.sentence: Actors memorize lines, but speakers must still think while talking.
examples.trans: 演员记台词，但说话的人仍须边说边想。

examples.sentence: What we memorize without context is the first knowledge we lose under pressure.
examples.trans: 没有语境记住的东西，是压力下一开始就会丢掉的知识。

effective.usageZh: 形容词，常修饰 way / method / strategy。副词 effectively；名词 effect。effective 强调“产生预期效果”。

examples.sentence: This is an effective way to remember names.
examples.trans: 这是记住名字的有效方法。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise is an effective way to keep healthy.
examples.trans: 规律运动是保持健康的有效方式。

examples.sentence: Short daily reviews are more effective than a long cram the night before.
examples.trans: 每天短复习比考前一晚突击更有效。

examples.sentence: An effective plan names the next action, not only the dream.
examples.trans: 有效的计划点名下一步行动，不只点名梦想。

examples.sentence: Feedback is effective only when the learner can still change the work.
examples.trans: 只有学习者还能改作业时，反馈才有效。

examples.sentence: An effective policy is one whose costs are visible and whose benefits can be checked.
examples.trans: 有效的政策是成本看得见、收益可核对的政策。

keen.usageZh: 形容词。be keen on (doing) sth / be keen to do。表示热切、感兴趣，语气强于 interested。

examples.sentence: I am keen on English songs.
examples.trans: 我热衷于英文歌。

examples.sentence: Many students are keen on participating in the school's science club.
examples.trans: 许多学生热衷于参加学校的科学社。

examples.sentence: He is keen to try a new language this term.
examples.trans: 他这学期很想试一门新语言。

examples.sentence: Stay keen on the craft even when progress looks slow.
examples.trans: 即使进步看起来很慢，也要对这门手艺保持热忱。

examples.sentence: A keen observer notices the small words that carry the tone.
examples.trans: 敏锐的观察者能注意到携带语气的小词。

examples.sentence: Keen interest without a method becomes a pile of unused apps.
examples.trans: 没有方法的热忱会变成一堆不用的应用。

patient.usageZh: 形容词：be patient with sb。名词 patience；也可作名词“病人”，本题取“有耐心的”。

examples.sentence: Please be patient with me.
examples.trans: 请对我有耐心。

examples.sentence: A good teacher is always patient with students who have questions.
examples.trans: 好老师对有问题的学生总是有耐心。

examples.sentence: Learning tones in a new language needs a patient ear.
examples.trans: 学新语言的声调需要一只有耐心的耳朵。

examples.sentence: Patient revision beats angry cramming before a test.
examples.trans: 考前耐心复习胜过愤怒突击。

examples.sentence: A patient mentor waits for the student to finish the sentence.
examples.trans: 有耐心的导师会等学生把句子说完。

examples.sentence: Being patient is a method: you wait for the pattern to appear in the data.
examples.trans: 有耐心是一种方法：你等模式在数据里出现。

partner.usageZh: 可数名词：language partner / pair work。动词也可表示搭档。

examples.sentence: Find a partner for the dialogue.
examples.trans: 找一个搭档练对话。

examples.sentence: In the pair work activity, everyone needs to find a partner to practice the dialogue.
examples.trans: 两人活动中，每个人都要找搭档练对话。

examples.sentence: A kind partner waits and does not finish your sentence for you.
examples.trans: 友善的搭档会等，而不会替你把句子说完。

examples.sentence: Your language partner should correct you, not only praise you.
examples.trans: 语伴应当纠正你，而不只是夸你。

examples.sentence: A weak partnership talks a lot and practises little.
examples.trans: 薄弱的搭档关系说得多、练得少。

examples.sentence: Choosing a partner is choosing the standard you will hear every week.
examples.trans: 选搭档，就是选你每周会听到的标准。

stick.usageZh: 动词。stick to a plan / decision / habit。过去式 stuck。也可表示粘住。

examples.sentence: Stick to your plan this week.
examples.trans: 这周坚持你的计划。

examples.sentence: If you stick to your daily reading habit, your vocabulary will improve greatly.
examples.trans: 如果你坚持每天阅读，词汇量会大有提高。

examples.sentence: I stuck the new word list on the wall by my desk.
examples.trans: 我把新词表贴在书桌旁的墙上。

examples.sentence: To stick to a timetable you must make it small enough to keep.
examples.trans: 要坚持时间表，就得把它做得小到能守住。

examples.sentence: People stick to methods that once worked, even after they stop working.
examples.trans: 人们会坚持曾经有效的方法，即使已经失效。

examples.sentence: Sticking to a weak strategy is not discipline; it is fear of redesign.
examples.trans: 坚持一套弱策略不是纪律，而是害怕重新设计。

encouragement.usageZh: 通常不可数：give / offer encouragement。动词 encourage。

examples.sentence: Her smile was real encouragement.
examples.trans: 她的微笑是真正的鼓励。

examples.sentence: A little encouragement from parents can mean a lot to a child.
examples.trans: 父母一点点鼓励对孩子意义很大。

examples.sentence: Words of encouragement helped him finish the speech.
examples.trans: 鼓励的话帮他讲完了发言。

examples.sentence: Encouragement that names the next step is more useful than empty praise.
examples.trans: 点出下一步的鼓励比空洞赞美更有用。

examples.sentence: Public encouragement can freeze a shy speaker as easily as it can free one.
examples.trans: 当众鼓励既能放开害羞的说话者，也能把他冻住。

examples.sentence: The best encouragement is evidence that the effort already moved a needle.
examples.trans: 最好的鼓励，是努力已经推动指针的证据。

confidence.usageZh: 不可数：build / gain / lose confidence；with confidence；have confidence in。

examples.sentence: I spoke with more confidence today.
examples.trans: 我今天说话更有信心。

examples.sentence: With enough practice, you will speak English with more confidence.
examples.trans: 练够了，你说英语会更有信心。

examples.sentence: Confidence grows when a small talk goes well.
examples.trans: 一次小交谈顺利，信心就会增长。

examples.sentence: False confidence skips the drill; earned confidence comes from the drill.
examples.trans: 虚假自信跳过操练；挣来的自信来自操练。

examples.sentence: Confidence without a record of repair is just volume.
examples.trans: 没有修补记录的自信只是音量。

examples.sentence: Institutions that punish every slip destroy the confidence they claim to build.
examples.trans: 惩罚每一次失手的机构，会毁掉它们声称要建立的信心。

translation.usageZh: 可数指一篇译文，不可数指翻译行为。translation of sth；动词 translate A into B。

examples.sentence: This translation is clear and short.
examples.trans: 这篇译文清楚又短。

examples.sentence: This app provides instant translation from English to Chinese.
examples.trans: 这个应用提供英到中的即时翻译。

examples.sentence: A word-for-word translation often sounds strange.
examples.trans: 逐词翻译听起来常常古怪。

examples.sentence: Good translation carries tone, not only dictionary sense.
examples.trans: 好的翻译带走语气，不只带走词典义。

examples.sentence: Machine translation is a draft, not a finished judgement.
examples.trans: 机器翻译是草稿，不是完成的判断。

examples.sentence: Every translation is an interpretation under a stricter contract with the source.
examples.trans: 每一次翻译都是与原文契约更严的阐释。

intermediate.usageZh: 形容词，描述学习者或课程的中级水平，介于 beginner 与 advanced 之间。

examples.sentence: This book is for intermediate learners.
examples.trans: 这本书给中级学习者。

examples.sentence: This English course is designed for intermediate students.
examples.trans: 这门英语课是为中级学生设计的。

examples.sentence: At the intermediate stage you already know words you cannot yet use.
examples.trans: 到了中级，你已经认识还不会用的词。

examples.sentence: Intermediate plateau is normal; change the task, not only the hours.
examples.trans: 中级平台期很正常；要改任务，不只改时长。

examples.sentence: An intermediate speaker needs harder input, not only easier praise.
examples.trans: 中级说话者需要更难的输入，而不只是更容易的夸奖。

examples.sentence: The intermediate years decide whether a language becomes a tool or a souvenir.
examples.trans: 中级那几年决定一门语言会变成工具还是纪念品。

advanced.usageZh: 形容词：advanced course / learner / technology。动词 advance。

examples.sentence: My sister is in an advanced class.
examples.trans: 我姐姐在高级班。

examples.sentence: The university offers advanced courses in computer science.
examples.trans: 这所大学开设计算机科学的高级课程。

examples.sentence: Advanced learners still need slow, careful reading.
examples.trans: 高级学习者仍需要慢而仔细的阅读。

examples.sentence: An advanced certificate does not prove you can argue in the language.
examples.trans: 一张高级证书不能证明你能用这门语言辩论。

examples.sentence: Advanced tools fail if the question is still vague.
examples.trans: 如果问题仍然含糊，高级工具也会失败。

examples.sentence: What looks advanced is often just earlier practice that nobody saw.
examples.trans: 看起来高级的东西，常常只是没人看见的更早练习。

inaccurate.usageZh: 形容词，反义词 accurate。描述信息、翻译、预报等“不准确”。

examples.sentence: The map was inaccurate, so we got lost.
examples.trans: 地图不准确，所以我们迷路了。

examples.sentence: The weather forecast was inaccurate, as it didn't rain at all.
examples.trans: 天气预报不准确，因为根本没下雨。

examples.sentence: An inaccurate translation can start a real argument.
examples.trans: 不准确的译文能引发真正的争执。

examples.sentence: Inaccurate notes are worse than no notes, because they feel trustworthy.
examples.trans: 不准确的笔记比没有笔记更糟，因为它们显得可信。

examples.sentence: An inaccurate citation is a small error with a large cost in trust.
examples.trans: 不准确的引文是小错，信任上的代价却大。

examples.sentence: Policy built on inaccurate data will look confident until it meets the street.
examples.trans: 建在不准确数据上的政策，会显得自信，直到它碰到街道。

communicate.usageZh: 动词：communicate with sb；communicate ideas to sb。名词 communication。

examples.sentence: We communicate in English in class.
examples.trans: 我们课上用英语交流。

examples.sentence: It's important for family members to communicate openly with each other.
examples.trans: 家庭成员开诚布公地交流很重要。

examples.sentence: In the modern world, it is essential to communicate effectively in both your native and foreign languages.
examples.trans: 在现代世界，用母语和外语有效交流都很必要。

examples.sentence: To communicate well, you listen as carefully as you speak.
examples.trans: 要交流得好，听和说一样仔细。

examples.sentence: We communicate status with silence as often as with words.
examples.trans: 我们用沉默交流地位，次数不亚于用词。

examples.sentence: Failure to communicate is often a failure to imagine the other person's constraints.
examples.trans: 交流失败常常是未能设想对方的约束。

familiar.usageZh: 形容词：be familiar with sth；sth is familiar to sb。反义词 unfamiliar。

examples.sentence: This song sounds familiar to me.
examples.trans: 这首歌听起来我很熟。

examples.sentence: The song sounds familiar to me, but I can't remember its name.
examples.trans: 这首歌听着熟，但我记不起名字。

examples.sentence: Become familiar with the stress pattern before you speed up.
examples.trans: 加速之前先熟悉重音模式。

examples.sentence: A familiar phrase can hide a grammar you have never actually checked.
examples.trans: 熟悉的短语可能藏着你从未真正核对过的语法。

examples.sentence: Familiar streets still require a map when the lights are out.
examples.trans: 熟悉的街道在灯灭时仍需要地图。

examples.sentence: Over-familiar examples make a textbook feel kind and a mind go to sleep.
examples.trans: 过于熟悉的例子让课本显得友善，也让头脑睡着。

properly.usageZh: 副词，修饰动词：do sth properly。形容词 proper。

examples.sentence: Hold the pen properly, please.
examples.trans: 请把笔握正确。

examples.sentence: You must learn how to use this machine properly to avoid accidents.
examples.trans: 你必须学会正确使用这台机器以免出事。

examples.sentence: If you do not rest properly, your memory will not keep the new words.
examples.trans: 如果你休息不得当，记忆就留不住新词。

examples.sentence: A citation that is not formatted properly can still be honest, but it looks careless.
examples.trans: 格式不得当的引文仍可能诚实，但看起来粗心。

examples.sentence: To argue properly is to steel-man the other side first.
examples.trans: 要辩论得当，先把对方的论点说到最强。

examples.sentence: Institutions fail when nobody is named to check whether the rule is followed properly.
examples.trans: 当没人被点名去核对规则是否被正确遵守时，机构就会失败。

experience.usageZh: 不可数指经验，可数指一次经历。have experience in；a valuable experience。

examples.sentence: It was a happy experience.
examples.trans: 那是一次愉快的经历。

examples.sentence: Working as a volunteer was a valuable experience for her.
examples.trans: 做志愿者对她是一次宝贵经历。

examples.sentence: Experience of speaking, not only of listening, builds the mouth.
examples.trans: 开口的经历，而不只是听的经历，才能练出嘴巴。

examples.sentence: Experience is a teacher only if you write down what went wrong.
examples.trans: 只有写下哪里出错，经历才是老师。

examples.sentence: An experienced speaker still rehearses the first thirty seconds.
examples.trans: 有经验的说话者仍会排练前三十秒。

examples.sentence: Lived experience is evidence, but it is not the only kind of evidence.
examples.trans: 亲身经历是证据，但不是唯一一种证据。

pronunciation.usageZh: 通常不可数。improve / practise pronunciation。动词 pronounce。

examples.sentence: Her pronunciation is clear and slow.
examples.trans: 她的发音清楚又慢。

examples.sentence: Listening to native speakers can help you improve your pronunciation.
examples.trans: 听母语者说话能帮你改进发音。

examples.sentence: Pronunciation carries attitude as well as sound.
examples.trans: 发音既带走声音，也带走态度。

examples.sentence: A small pronunciation error can still block a name or a number.
examples.trans: 很小的发音错误仍可能挡住一个名字或数字。

examples.sentence: Pronunciation work belongs beside vocabulary, not after it.
examples.trans: 发音训练应与词汇并行，而不是排在后面。

examples.sentence: Judging intelligence by pronunciation is a cheap and common prejudice.
examples.trans: 凭发音判断智力，是廉价而常见的偏见。

phrase.usageZh: 可数名词：a useful phrase；set phrase。动词 phrase 表示措辞。

examples.sentence: Write this phrase in your notebook.
examples.trans: 把这个短语写进笔记本。

examples.sentence: 'How do you do?' is a common greeting phrase in English.
examples.trans: How do you do? 是英语里常见的问候短语。

examples.sentence: A phrase is easier to reuse than a lonely word.
examples.trans: 短语比孤零零的单词更容易再利用。

examples.sentence: Collect phrases that do a job, not phrases that only look rare.
examples.trans: 收集能办事的短语，而不是仅仅看起来稀有的短语。

examples.sentence: A frozen phrase can stop you from building the grammar underneath.
examples.trans: 冻结的短语可能阻止你构建底下的语法。

examples.sentence: The phrase you cannot paraphrase is the one you do not yet own.
examples.trans: 你无法改写的短语，就是你尚未拥有的那一个。

support.usageZh: 可作名词或动词。give / offer support；support sb in doing。本题课文多用名词。

examples.sentence: My family gives me support.
examples.trans: 我的家人给我支持。

examples.sentence: Emotional support from a friend can calm a hard week.
examples.trans: 朋友的情感支持能让艰难的一周平静下来。

examples.sentence: Teachers support students who try, not only students who already succeed.
examples.trans: 老师支持去试的学生，而不只是已经成功的学生。

examples.sentence: Support without honesty becomes a soft kind of harm.
examples.trans: 没有诚实的支持会变成一种柔软的伤害。

examples.sentence: Public support for a policy fades if the costs stay unnamed.
examples.trans: 如果成本一直不被点名，公众对政策的支持就会消退。

examples.sentence: The support a learner needs is often a better task, not a louder cheer.
examples.trans: 学习者需要的支持常常是更好的任务，而不是更大声的加油。

essential.usageZh: 形容词：be essential for / to。也可作名词 essentials 必需品。

examples.sentence: Water is essential for life.
examples.trans: 水对生命是必要的。

examples.sentence: Water is essential for all living things to survive.
examples.trans: 水对所有生物生存都是必要的。

examples.sentence: It is essential to communicate clearly in a team.
examples.trans: 在团队里清楚交流是必要的。

examples.sentence: Sleep is essential to memory, however busy the timetable looks.
examples.trans: 无论时间表看起来多忙，睡眠对记忆都是必要的。

examples.sentence: Essential skills are the ones you still need when the app is down.
examples.trans: 必要技能是应用宕机时你仍需要的那些。

examples.sentence: What a syllabus calls essential is a choice, not a law of nature.
examples.trans: 大纲称为必要的东西是一种选择，不是自然法则。

perception.usageZh: 通常不可数：perception of。动词 perceive。指看法或感知方式。

examples.sentence: Travel changed her perception of the city.
examples.trans: 旅行改变了她对这座城市的看法。

examples.sentence: Traveling broadens our perception of the world.
examples.trans: 旅行拓宽我们对世界的感知。

examples.sentence: A first perception is often a stereotype wearing a smile.
examples.trans: 第一感知常常是面带微笑的刻板印象。

examples.sentence: Perception of an accent is not the same as a measure of clarity.
examples.trans: 对口音的感知并不等于对清晰度的测量。

examples.sentence: Media can narrow perception while claiming to widen it.
examples.trans: 媒体可以在声称拓宽感知的同时收窄它。

examples.sentence: A culture's perception of politeness is a rulebook nobody prints.
examples.trans: 一种文化对礼貌的感知，是一本没人印刷的规则书。

master.usageZh: 及物动词：master a language / skill。也可作名词“大师；主人”。名词 mastery。

examples.sentence: I want to master this song.
examples.trans: 我想掌握这首歌。

examples.sentence: It takes years of practice to master a musical instrument.
examples.trans: 掌握一种乐器需要多年练习。

examples.sentence: You do not master a tense by circling it once in a workbook.
examples.trans: 在练习册上圈一次，并不能掌握一个时态。

examples.sentence: To master a register you must hear it in the wild, not only in drills.
examples.trans: 要掌握一种语域，必须在野外听见它，而不只在操练里。

examples.sentence: Mastery is the ability to slow down, not only to speed up.
examples.trans: 精通是能放慢的能力，而不只是能加快。

examples.sentence: Those who claim to master a culture after a summer have confused exposure with understanding.
examples.trans: 暑假结束后声称掌握一种文化的人，把接触错当成了理解。

access.usageZh: 名词常与 to 连用：have access to。也可作动词“访问（系统/文件）”。

examples.sentence: Students have access to the library.
examples.trans: 学生可以使用图书馆。

examples.sentence: Nowadays, students have easy access to online learning resources.
examples.trans: 如今学生很容易获得在线学习资源。

examples.sentence: Access to a quiet room is part of studying, not a luxury.
examples.trans: 能使用安静房间是学习的一部分，不是奢侈。

examples.sentence: Access without guidance produces a pile of unread files.
examples.trans: 没有指导的使用权会堆出一叠未读文件。

examples.sentence: Unequal access to broadband is an education policy, whether named or not.
examples.trans: 宽带使用权不平等就是教育政策，无论点名与否。

examples.sentence: To grant access is easy; to make the archive usable is the real labour.
examples.trans: 授予访问权很容易；让档案真正能用才是真正的劳动。

inconvenience.usageZh: 通常不可数：cause inconvenience。形容词 inconvenient。也可作动词。

examples.sentence: The late bus caused inconvenience.
examples.trans: 晚到的公交造成了不便。

examples.sentence: I apologize for any inconvenience caused by the road construction.
examples.trans: 道路施工造成的不便，我表示歉意。

examples.sentence: A little inconvenience now can save a larger mess later.
examples.trans: 现在一点点不便，可以省掉后来更大的乱。

examples.sentence: Call the delay an inconvenience if you wish, but name the people who wait.
examples.trans: 你可以把延误称为不便，但要点名那些等待的人。

examples.sentence: Systems that hide inconvenience from customers usually dump it on staff.
examples.trans: 对顾客隐藏不便的系统，通常把不便卸给员工。

examples.sentence: The language of inconvenience can soften a harm that should stay sharp.
examples.trans: “不便”这种说法，可能把本该保持锋利的伤害磨软。

resources.usageZh: 常用复数：learning / online / natural resources。单数 resource。

examples.sentence: The library has many resources.
examples.trans: 图书馆有许多资源。

examples.sentence: Our school library has rich resources for science research.
examples.trans: 我校图书馆有丰富的科学研究资源。

examples.sentence: Free resources online still need a plan, or they become noise.
examples.trans: 网上的免费资源仍需要计划，否则会变成噪音。

examples.sentence: Public resources are not free if someone else's time paid for them.
examples.trans: 公共资源并不免费，如果是别人的时间付的账。

examples.sentence: Scarce resources force a syllabus to choose, and every choice leaves a gap.
examples.trans: 稀缺资源迫使大纲做出选择，而每个选择都会留下缺口。

examples.sentence: Open educational resources fail when nobody maintains the links.
examples.trans: 没人维护链接时，开放教育资源就会失败。

afford.usageZh: 及物动词，常与 can / could 连用：cannot afford sth / to do。

examples.sentence: I cannot afford that game.
examples.trans: 我买不起那个游戏。

examples.sentence: With his new job, he can finally afford to buy a car.
examples.trans: 有了新工作，他终于买得起车了。

examples.sentence: We cannot afford to skip sleep before the test.
examples.trans: 考试前我们不能把睡眠省掉。

examples.sentence: A city that cannot afford quiet libraries has already chosen its future.
examples.trans: 负担不起安静图书馆的城市，已经选好了自己的未来。

examples.sentence: You cannot afford to be vague when the contract names a date.
examples.trans: 合同点名日期时，你含糊不起。

examples.sentence: Societies that cannot afford slow thinking will buy fast mistakes.
examples.trans: 负担不起慢思考的社会，会买来快的错误。

advantages.usageZh: 可数，常用复数。have advantages over；one of the advantages of。

examples.sentence: This seat has two advantages.
examples.trans: 这个座位有两个优点。

examples.sentence: One of the advantages of living in a city is the convenience of public transport.
examples.trans: 住在城市的优点之一是公交方便。

examples.sentence: List the advantages before you list the fears.
examples.trans: 先列出优势，再列出恐惧。

examples.sentence: Hidden advantages of bilingual homes show up in jokes, not only in tests.
examples.trans: 双语家庭的隐性优势出现在笑话里，而不只在考试里。

examples.sentence: Comparative advantages change when the network changes.
examples.trans: 当网络改变时，比较优势也会改变。

examples.sentence: Advertising sells advantages; a contract should sell constraints.
examples.trans: 广告卖优势；合同应当卖约束。

affordable.usageZh: 形容词，描述价格合理、负担得起的商品或服务。

examples.sentence: This lunch is affordable for students.
examples.trans: 这顿午饭对学生来说负担得起。

examples.sentence: The government is trying to provide affordable housing for young people.
examples.trans: 政府正努力为年轻人提供负担得起的住房。

examples.sentence: Affordable tools matter more than fancy ones you never open.
examples.trans: 负担得起的工具，比你从不打开的花哨工具更重要。

examples.sentence: Affordable broadband is an education issue wearing a tech label.
examples.trans: 负担得起的宽带是贴着科技标签的教育问题。

examples.sentence: If the only affordable option is the lowest quality, the market has failed.
examples.trans: 如果唯一负担得起的选项是最低质量，市场就已经失败。

examples.sentence: An affordable public option can discipline prices that private brands will not.
examples.trans: 负担得起的公共选项，可以约束私人品牌不愿约束的价格。

widespread.usageZh: 形容词：widespread use / problem / support。作定语或表语。

examples.sentence: Smartphones are widespread now.
examples.trans: 智能手机现在很普遍。

examples.sentence: The use of smartphones is now widespread even in rural areas.
examples.trans: 即便在乡村，智能手机的使用现在也很普遍。

examples.sentence: Widespread copying does not make a sentence yours.
examples.trans: 普遍抄袭并不能让一句话变成你的。

examples.sentence: A widespread myth can outrun a careful paper for years.
examples.trans: 一个广泛流传的迷思可以跑赢一篇谨慎的论文许多年。

examples.sentence: Widespread access is not the same as widespread skill.
examples.trans: 广泛的使用权并不等于广泛的技能。

examples.sentence: When distrust is widespread, fact-checking looks like a side hobby.
examples.trans: 当不信任普遍存在时，事实核对看起来像业余爱好。

ignored.usageZh: ignore 的过去分词/过去式，常用于 should not be ignored。动词 ignore。

examples.sentence: The warning was ignored, and the plant died.
examples.trans: 警告被忽视了，植物死了。

examples.sentence: The teacher's advice should not be ignored if you want to improve.
examples.trans: 若想提高，老师的建议不该被忽视。

examples.sentence: He ignored the first error, so the second one grew.
examples.trans: 他忽视了第一个错误，于是第二个长大了。

examples.sentence: Small errors ignored in a draft become large errors in public.
examples.trans: 草稿里被忽视的小错，会在公开场合变成大错。

examples.sentence: A complaint ignored twice is a policy, whether anyone wrote it down.
examples.trans: 被忽视两次的投诉就是政策，无论有没有人写下来。

examples.sentence: Data that is ignored because it is inconvenient is still data.
examples.trans: 因为不便而被忽视的数据，仍然是数据。

continuous.usageZh: 形容词：continuous rain / contact / progress。注意与 continual（频繁发生）的细微差别。

examples.sentence: We had continuous rain for two days.
examples.trans: 我们连续下了两天雨。

examples.sentence: Three days of continuous rain caused flooding in some areas.
examples.trans: 连续三天的雨造成一些地区洪水。

examples.sentence: Language needs continuous contact, not a heroic weekend.
examples.trans: 语言需要持续接触，而不是英勇的一个周末。

examples.sentence: Continuous assessment can be kinder than one brutal final.
examples.trans: 持续评估可以比一次残酷的期末更仁慈。

examples.sentence: A continuous feed of alerts is not the same as continuous attention.
examples.trans: 持续不断的提醒，并不等于持续的注意力。

examples.sentence: Continuous growth is a slogan; most real curves rest, then climb.
examples.trans: 持续增长是口号；大多数真实曲线会停一停，再爬。

contact.usageZh: 常作不可数名词：make / keep / lose contact with。也可作动词。

examples.sentence: Please keep contact with your partner.
examples.trans: 请与搭档保持联系。

examples.sentence: I lost contact with my primary school friend after she moved abroad.
examples.trans: 小学朋友出国后，我和她失去了联系。

examples.sentence: Face-to-face contact still teaches tone that text cannot.
examples.trans: 面对面的接触仍能教文字教不了的语气。

examples.sentence: Professional contact is a resource you maintain, not a list you hoard.
examples.trans: 职业联系是你维护的资源，不是囤积的名单。

examples.sentence: Too much contact without a task becomes noise wearing a smile.
examples.trans: 没有任务的过多接触，会变成面带微笑的噪音。

examples.sentence: When institutions lose contact with the street, their language grows abstract.
examples.trans: 当机构与街道失去接触，它们的语言会变得抽象。

progress.usageZh: 通常不可数：make progress。也可作动词，重音在第二音节。

examples.sentence: I am making progress this month.
examples.trans: 我这个月在进步。

examples.sentence: She has made great progress in her English speaking this term.
examples.trans: 她这学期英语口语有了很大进步。

examples.sentence: Slow progress is still progress if you can describe it.
examples.trans: 慢的进步仍是进步——如果你能描述它。

examples.sentence: Progress is easier to see in a diary than in a single evening.
examples.trans: 进步在日记里比在单个晚上更容易看见。

examples.sentence: Real progress is uneven; plateaus are part of the curve.
examples.trans: 真正的进步是不均匀的；平台期是曲线的一部分。

examples.sentence: Progress that cannot be measured will not be funded, for better or worse.
examples.trans: 无法测量的进步不会得到资助，无论这是好事还是坏事。

ability.usageZh: 可数或不可数：ability to do；improve one's ability。形容词 able。

examples.sentence: He has the ability to run fast.
examples.trans: 他有跑得快的能力。

examples.sentence: His ability to solve complex problems impressed everyone.
examples.trans: 他解决复杂问题的能力让所有人印象深刻。

examples.sentence: Ability grows in the hour you almost quit.
examples.trans: 能力在你几乎放弃的那一小时里生长。

examples.sentence: An unused ability rusts the way an unused language does.
examples.trans: 不用的能力会生锈，就像不用的语言一样。

examples.sentence: We confuse ability with speed, and then punish the careful student.
examples.trans: 我们把能力错当成速度，然后惩罚细心的学生。

examples.sentence: Equal dignity does not require equal ability; it requires a fair chance to practise.
examples.trans: 平等尊严不要求同等能力；它要求公平的练习机会。

improve.usageZh: 及物或不及物：improve one's English；things improve。名词 improvement。

examples.sentence: I want to improve my English.
examples.trans: 我想提高英语。

examples.sentence: You need to practice regularly if you want to improve your writing.
examples.trans: 若想提高写作，你需要规律练习。

examples.sentence: You improve a skill by using it when it still feels clumsy.
examples.trans: 技能还笨拙时就去用，才能提高它。

examples.sentence: To improve a system, change one variable and keep a record.
examples.trans: 要改进系统，就改一个变量并留下记录。

examples.sentence: Improvement that nobody can describe will not survive the next timetable.
examples.trans: 没人能描述的提高，活不过下一张时间表。

examples.sentence: Institutions improve when error is cheap to report and expensive to hide.
examples.trans: 当报错便宜、隐瞒昂贵时，机构才会改进。

attitude.usageZh: 可数：a positive attitude towards / to。change one's attitude。

examples.sentence: A kind attitude helps in class.
examples.trans: 友善的态度在课上有帮助。

examples.sentence: Her attitude towards mistakes is calm and useful.
examples.trans: 她对待错误的态度冷静而有用。

examples.sentence: Attitude is not a poster; it is what you do after a bad mark.
examples.trans: 态度不是海报；它是坏分数之后你做什么。

examples.sentence: A defensive attitude turns feedback into an attack.
examples.trans: 防御性态度会把反馈变成攻击。

examples.sentence: Attitude towards uncertainty predicts who stays with a hard language.
examples.trans: 对不确定性的态度，能预测谁会守住一门难语言。

examples.sentence: Public attitude can shift faster than law, and slower than a slogan expects.
examples.trans: 公众态度可以比法律转得更快，也比口号预期的更慢。

learn a new language.usageZh: 动词短语，表示开始并持续学习一门新的语言，常与 challenging / rewarding 连用。

examples.sentence: I want to learn a new language this year.
examples.trans: 我今年想学一门新语言。

examples.sentence: Many people find it challenging but rewarding to learn a new language.
examples.trans: 许多人觉得学新语言有挑战，但值得。

examples.sentence: Children can learn a new language through songs and games.
examples.trans: 孩子可以通过歌曲和游戏学新语言。

examples.sentence: To learn a new language as an adult is to accept looking foolish in public.
examples.trans: 成年后再学新语言，就是接受在公开场合显得傻。

examples.sentence: People who learn a new language late still reshape the brain; the myth of the closed window is lazy.
examples.trans: 晚学新语言的人仍在重塑大脑；“窗户已关”的迷思是懒惰。

examples.sentence: A state that funds citizens to learn a new language is investing in diplomacy at street level.
examples.trans: 资助公民学新语言的国家，是在街巷层面投资外交。

stay keen on.usageZh: stay keen on (doing) sth 表示对某事保持热情，即使变难也不冷却。

examples.sentence: Stay keen on your hobby this term.
examples.trans: 这学期对你的爱好保持热情。

examples.sentence: To succeed in any hobby, you must stay keen on it even when it gets difficult.
examples.trans: 任何爱好要成功，难的时候也得保持热情。

examples.sentence: She stayed keen on Japanese after the first hard month.
examples.trans: 第一个难月过后，她仍对日语保持热情。

examples.sentence: Stay keen on the questions, not only on the scores.
examples.trans: 对问题保持热情，而不只对分数。

examples.sentence: It is harder to stay keen on a craft when nobody nearby shares it.
examples.trans: 附近没人分享时，更难对一门手艺保持热情。

examples.sentence: Institutions that want talent must help people stay keen on slow work.
examples.trans: 想要人才的机构，必须帮人们对慢工保持热情。

stick to it.usageZh: stick to it 口语，表示坚持做下去。代词 it 指已提及的计划或习惯。过去式 stuck to it。

examples.sentence: The plan is simple. Stick to it.
examples.trans: 计划很简单。坚持下去。

examples.sentence: Making a plan is easy, but the real challenge is to stick to it.
examples.trans: 做计划容易，真正的挑战是坚持下去。

examples.sentence: He stuck to it for thirty days and then the habit felt lighter.
examples.trans: 他坚持了三十天，然后习惯就轻了。

examples.sentence: Stick to it long enough to collect evidence, then redesign if needed.
examples.trans: 坚持到能收集证据，然后再决定是否重新设计。

examples.sentence: People confuse sticking to it with refusing to learn.
examples.trans: 人们把坚持下去错当成拒绝学习。

examples.sentence: A lab that cannot stick to it for a dull month will not publish a careful paper.
examples.trans: 无法在乏味的一个月里坚持下去的实验室，发表不了谨慎的论文。

work towards.usageZh: work towards + n./doing 表示为某目标持续努力，强调过程。

examples.sentence: We work towards a class play in June.
examples.trans: 我们朝着六月的班级话剧努力。

examples.sentence: We should all work towards creating a better environment for our community.
examples.trans: 我们都应为社区创造更好的环境而努力。

examples.sentence: She is working towards a fluent ten-minute talk.
examples.trans: 她正朝着一段流利的十分钟发言努力。

examples.sentence: Work towards a standard you can check on Friday, not a foggy dream.
examples.trans: 朝着周五能检查的标准努力，而不是雾蒙蒙的梦想。

examples.sentence: Teams that work towards the same metric still need a shared definition of it.
examples.trans: 朝同一指标努力的团队，仍需要对它有共同定义。

examples.sentence: A city that works towards inclusion must budget for translation, not only for posters.
examples.trans: 朝包容努力的城市，必须为翻译做预算，而不只为海报。

talk to yourself.usageZh: talk to yourself 可指自言自语，语言学习中是合法的出声练习。

examples.sentence: Talk to yourself when you practise the dialogue.
examples.trans: 练对话时请对自己说话。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, when you need to organize your thoughts, it helps to talk to yourself.
examples.trans: 需要整理思绪时，对自己说话会有帮助。

examples.sentence: Talk to yourself in the new language while you cook.
examples.trans: 做饭时用新语言对自己说话。

examples.sentence: To talk to yourself is cheap fluency practice with zero social risk.
examples.trans: 对自己说话是零社交风险的廉价流利练习。

examples.sentence: If you never talk to yourself in the target language, you wait forever for a perfect partner.
examples.trans: 若你从不在目标语里对自己说话，就会永远等待完美搭档。

examples.sentence: Inner speech is still speech: talk to yourself, then write down the phrases that worked.
examples.trans: 内心言语仍是言语：对自己说话，再写下管用的短语。

build up.usageZh: 短语动词：build up confidence / vocabulary / strength。强调逐渐积累。

examples.sentence: Reading helps me build up new words.
examples.trans: 阅读帮我积累新词。

examples.sentence: Reading every day can help you build up a large vocabulary over time.
examples.trans: 每天阅读能帮你逐渐积累大量词汇。

examples.sentence: She built up the courage to speak in the meeting.
examples.trans: 她逐渐鼓起勇气在会上发言。

examples.sentence: Build up a file of your own errors; it is a private textbook.
examples.trans: 积累一份你自己的错误档案；那是私人课本。

examples.sentence: Trust is built up slowly and spent quickly.
examples.trans: 信任是慢慢建立、很快花掉的。

examples.sentence: A reputation built up over a decade can be spent in a single inaccurate headline.
examples.trans: 十年建立的名声，可以在一条不准确的标题里花光。

have fun with.usageZh: have fun with sth 表示在做某事时获得乐趣，学习语境中强调玩中学。

examples.sentence: Have fun with the new game.
examples.trans: 和新游戏玩得开心。

examples.sentence: You can have fun with science by doing simple experiments at home.
examples.trans: 你可以在家做简单实验，从科学中获得乐趣。

examples.sentence: Have fun with the sounds before you worry about the spelling.
examples.trans: 先从声音中获得乐趣，再担心拼写。

examples.sentence: If you cannot have fun with a language, you will not stay long enough to get good.
examples.trans: 如果不能从一门语言中获得乐趣，你就不会留得够久以至于变好。

examples.sentence: Teachers who have fun with the material do not make the work less serious.
examples.trans: 对材料有乐趣的老师，并不会让工作变得不严肃。

examples.sentence: A culture that cannot have fun with its second language will treat it as a test forever.
examples.trans: 不能从第二语言中获得乐趣的文化，会永远把它当考试。

focus on.usageZh: focus on + n./doing 表示把注意力集中在某事上。名词 focus。

examples.sentence: Please focus on the teacher now.
examples.trans: 现在请专注于老师。

examples.sentence: During the exam, you need to focus on the questions and avoid distractions.
examples.trans: 考试时你需要专注题目，避开干扰。

examples.sentence: Focus on one tense this week, not on ten new apps.
examples.trans: 这周专注一个时态，而不是十个新应用。

examples.sentence: Focus on the constraint that actually blocks you.
examples.trans: 专注真正挡住你的那个约束。

examples.sentence: A team that cannot focus on a single metric will decorate every slide.
examples.trans: 无法专注单一指标的团队，会装饰每一张幻灯片。

examples.sentence: To focus on equity is to name who is missing from the room.
examples.trans: 专注于公平，就是点名谁不在这个房间里。

make mistakes.usageZh: make mistakes 是学习过程的正常部分。don't be afraid to make mistakes。

examples.sentence: I make mistakes, and that is all right.
examples.trans: 我犯错，那没关系。

examples.sentence: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when you are learning to play a new sport.
examples.trans: 学新运动时不要害怕犯错。

examples.sentence: Good learners make mistakes and then repair them in a notebook.
examples.trans: 好的学习者犯错，然后在笔记本里修好。

examples.sentence: To make mistakes in public is a cheap form of courage.
examples.trans: 当众犯错是一种廉价的勇气。

examples.sentence: A classroom that forbids making mistakes forbids learning.
examples.trans: 禁止犯错的课堂禁止学习。

examples.sentence: Making mistakes is data if you keep the record; otherwise it is only noise.
examples.trans: 犯错是数据——如果你保留记录；否则只是噪音。

get your meaning.usageZh: get your meaning 表示听懂你要表达的意思，强调交际成功而非完美语法。

examples.sentence: Speak slowly so I can get your meaning.
examples.trans: 说慢一点，好让我理解你的意思。

examples.sentence: When giving directions, use clear words so people can easily get your meaning.
examples.trans: 指路时用清楚的词，好让人容易理解你的意思。

examples.sentence: Gestures help listeners get your meaning when a word is missing.
examples.trans: 缺词时，手势能帮听者理解你的意思。

examples.sentence: If they get your meaning, the grammar can be repaired on the next turn.
examples.trans: 如果他们理解了你的意思，语法可以在下一轮修好。

examples.sentence: Writers who only decorate sentences often fail to get their meaning across.
examples.trans: 只装饰句子的写作者常常无法让人理解意思。

examples.sentence: Diplomacy fails when each side hears the tone and nobody gets your meaning.
examples.trans: 当双方只听见语气、没人理解你的意思时，外交就会失败。

communicate with.usageZh: communicate with sb 表示与某人交流。也可 communicate with an audience。

examples.sentence: I communicate with my grandma on the phone.
examples.trans: 我用电话和奶奶交流。

examples.sentence: It is important for team members to communicate with each other clearly to finish the project.
examples.trans: 队员清楚地相互交流，对完成项目很重要。

examples.sentence: You can communicate with people abroad through short videos.
examples.trans: 你可以通过短视频和国外的人交流。

examples.sentence: To communicate with a sceptical reader, lead with the evidence.
examples.trans: 要与怀疑的读者交流，就先拿出证据。

examples.sentence: Doctors must communicate with families in plain language, not only in charts.
examples.trans: 医生必须用明白的语言与家属交流，而不只在图表里。

examples.sentence: A government that cannot communicate with its quiet towns will hear them only in a crisis.
examples.trans: 无法与安静小镇交流的政府，只会在危机里听见它们。

not only... but also....usageZh: 并列结构，连接词性相同的成分。not only 提前时需部分倒装。

examples.sentence: She is not only kind but also brave.
examples.trans: 她不仅善良而且勇敢。

examples.sentence: Reading not only broadens our horizons but also improves our writing skills.
examples.trans: 阅读不仅开阔视野，而且提高写作。

examples.sentence: He not only listened but also took notes.
examples.trans: 他不仅听了，还记了笔记。

examples.sentence: The course trains not only accuracy but also the courage to pause.
examples.trans: 这门课不仅训练准确，还训练停顿的勇气。

examples.sentence: Not only did the report list the facts, but it also named the missing voices.
examples.trans: 报告不仅列出事实，还点名了缺失的声音。

examples.sentence: A fair curriculum serves not only the exam but also the life after the exam.
examples.trans: 公平的课程不仅服务考试，也服务考试之后的生活。

The more..., the more....usageZh: 比较结构：The + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表示共变。两边都用比较级。

examples.sentence: The more you read, the more you know.
examples.trans: 你读得越多，知道得就越多。

examples.sentence: The more you practice, the more confident you will become.
examples.trans: 你练得越多，就会越自信。

examples.sentence: The more she listened, the more the jokes made sense.
examples.trans: 她听得越多，笑话就越说得通。

examples.sentence: The more precise the feedback, the more usable the next draft.
examples.trans: 反馈越精确，下一稿就越能用。

examples.sentence: The more a platform harvests attention, the more it must be regulated.
examples.trans: 平台收割的注意力越多，就越必须被监管。

examples.sentence: The more abstract the slogan, the more concrete the budget should be.
examples.trans: 口号越抽象，预算就应当越具体。

mother tongue.usageZh: 名词短语，指一个人的第一语言/母语。也可 native language。

examples.sentence: Chinese is my mother tongue.
examples.trans: 汉语是我的母语。

examples.sentence: Although he speaks English fluently, his mother tongue is Chinese.
examples.trans: 虽然他英语流利，母语却是汉语。

examples.sentence: Your mother tongue is a resource, not a rival of English.
examples.trans: 母语是资源，不是英语的对手。

examples.sentence: Shame about a mother tongue is a political wound, not a language fact.
examples.trans: 对母语的羞耻是政治伤口，不是语言事实。

examples.sentence: Writers who abandon a mother tongue still carry its rhythm into the new one.
examples.trans: 放弃母语的写作者，仍会把母语的节奏带进新语言。

examples.sentence: A school that forbids the mother tongue in the corridor teaches hierarchy, not English.
examples.trans: 禁止在走廊使用母语的学校，教的是等级，不是英语。

It goes without saying.usageZh: 固定表达，意为“不言而喻”。后常接 that 从句。语体偏正式。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that we should be kind.
examples.trans: 我们应该友善，这是不言而喻的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that health is more important than wealth.
examples.trans: 健康比财富重要，这是不言而喻的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that you must cite the source.
examples.trans: 你必须标明出处，这是不言而喻的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying that consent cannot be assumed from silence.
examples.trans: 不能从沉默里假定同意，这是不言而喻的。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying, yet it still needs writing down in the protocol.
examples.trans: 这是不言而喻的，却仍需要写进规程。

examples.sentence: It goes without saying in one culture and still needs a footnote in another.
examples.trans: 在一种文化里不言而喻的东西，在另一种文化里仍需要脚注。

face to face.usageZh: 副词性短语：meet / talk face to face。也可写作 face-to-face 作定语。

examples.sentence: I want to talk to her face to face.
examples.trans: 我想和她面对面谈。

examples.sentence: It's better to discuss this problem face to face rather than on the phone.
examples.trans: 这个问题最好面对面讨论，而不是打电话。

examples.sentence: We practised the dialogue face to face in the corridor.
examples.trans: 我们在走廊里面对面练习对话。

examples.sentence: Some conflicts only move when people sit face to face.
examples.trans: 有些冲突只有人们面对面坐下来才会移动。

examples.sentence: Face to face teaching still matters when the topic is shame or grief.
examples.trans: 当话题是羞耻或悲伤时，面对面教学仍然重要。

examples.sentence: A democracy that never meets face to face becomes a stack of comments.
examples.trans: 从不面对面相遇的民主，会变成一堆评论。

afford that.usageZh: afford that 中 that 指前文提到的费用或选择。cannot afford that 是否定常用式。

examples.sentence: The ticket is expensive. I cannot afford that.
examples.trans: 票很贵。我负担不起那个。

examples.sentence: The new smartphone is too expensive; I cannot afford that this month.
examples.trans: 新手机太贵；这个月我负担不起那个。

examples.sentence: A second course would help, but we cannot afford that fee now.
examples.trans: 第二门课会有帮助，但我们现在负担不起那笔费用。

examples.sentence: Delay looks cheap until you cannot afford that lost year.
examples.trans: 拖延看起来便宜，直到你负担不起那失去的一年。

examples.sentence: The city wants a stadium and a library; it cannot quietly afford that pair.
examples.trans: 城市想要一座体育场和一座图书馆；它不能悄悄负担得起那一对。

examples.sentence: If the public cannot afford that standard of care, the standard is a decoration.
examples.trans: 如果公众负担不起那种护理标准，标准就是装饰。

through the Internet.usageZh: 介词短语，表示途径：learn / buy / meet through the Internet。也可 online。

examples.sentence: I found the song through the Internet.
examples.trans: 我通过互联网找到了这首歌。

examples.sentence: Nowadays, we can buy almost anything through the Internet.
examples.trans: 如今我们几乎可以通过互联网买到任何东西。

examples.sentence: She met her language partner through the Internet last spring.
examples.trans: 她去年春天通过互联网认识了语伴。

examples.sentence: Advice collected through the Internet still needs a local check.
examples.trans: 通过互联网收集的建议仍需要本地核对。

examples.sentence: Friendship through the Internet can be real and still miss the body's cues.
examples.trans: 通过互联网的友谊可以真实，仍会错过身体的线索。

examples.sentence: Fraud travels faster through the Internet than through any older post.
examples.trans: 欺诈通过互联网旅行，比通过任何更旧的邮政都快。

distance education.usageZh: 名词短语，指远程教育。也可 distance learning。

examples.sentence: My cousin uses distance education at home.
examples.trans: 我表哥在家用远程教育。

examples.sentence: Distance education allows people in remote areas to access quality learning resources.
examples.trans: 远程教育让偏远地区的人获得优质学习资源。

examples.sentence: Distance education failed on the day the power went out.
examples.trans: 停电那天，远程教育失败了。

examples.sentence: Distance education is a logistics problem as much as a teaching problem.
examples.trans: 远程教育既是教学问题，也是后勤问题。

examples.sentence: Good distance education designs the pause, not only the video.
examples.trans: 好的远程教育设计停顿，而不只设计视频。

examples.sentence: Distance education without local tutors widens the gap it claims to close.
examples.trans: 没有本地导师的远程教育，会拉大它声称要弥合的差距。

stand still.usageZh: stand still 可指身体站着不动，也可比喻停滞不前。第三人称 stands still。

examples.sentence: Please stand still for the photo.
examples.trans: 拍照时请站着别动。

examples.sentence: Technology never stands still; it is always developing.
examples.trans: 技术从不停滞；它一直在发展。

examples.sentence: If your vocabulary stands still, your speaking will too.
examples.trans: 如果你的词汇停滞，口语也会停滞。

examples.sentence: A career that stands still is often a career that is afraid to choose.
examples.trans: 停滞的生涯常常是害怕选择的生涯。

examples.sentence: Markets do not stand still while a committee edits a paragraph.
examples.trans: 委员会改一段文字时，市场不会停滞。

examples.sentence: A language policy that stands still while the street changes will be ignored.
examples.trans: 街道在变而语言政策停滞，政策就会被忽视。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'would' for Polite Assumption / 情态动词'would'表示礼貌推测
grammar.title: 第二类条件句（虚拟现在/将来）及 If I were you / were to
grammar.titleEn: Second Conditional (unreal present/future) and related forms
grammar.usage:
第二类条件句表示现在或将来不太可能、或纯假设的情况。
结构：If + 过去时, 主句 would/could/might + 动词原形。
be 动词在正式语体中一律用 were（If I were you）。
否定：If he didn't complain so much, people would enjoy his company.
疑问：What would you do if you had a free year?
初中：先记 If I were you, I would...；不要和第一类（will）混用。
高中拓展：could/might 代替 would 表示可能性更弱；If sb were to do 表示将来假想；混合虚拟（If I had..., I would... now）到高三再对比。不要用 would 同时出现在 if 从句里（愿意义除外）。
forms: If + S + 过去时, S + would/could/might + V
If I were you, I would + V
If + S + were to + V, S + would + V
What would you do if ...?
对比：If + 现在, will（第一类真实条件）
notes: 主句用 would，不用 will。
if 从句用过去时，不是 would。
If I were you 比 If I was you 更适合书面语。
could/might 可以替换 would，语气不同。
与第一类的区别是“是否真实可能”。

examples.en: If I had a bike, I would ride to school.
examples.cn: 假如我有自行车，我会骑车去上学。

examples.en: If I were you, I would talk to my parents first.
examples.cn: 我要是你，我会先和父母谈谈。

examples.en: If she had more free time, she would socialize with her teammates after practice.
examples.cn: 假如她空闲更多，她会在训练后和队友交往。

examples.en: If the two companies established closer ties, they could exchange roles more smoothly.
examples.cn: 假如两家公司建立更紧密的联系，就能更顺畅地互换角色。

examples.en: If I were to confront the stereotype directly, I might lose some shallow popularity.
examples.cn: 倘若我直接面对这种刻板印象，或许会失去一些肤浅的欢迎度。

examples.en: If public debate were truly frank, fewer rumours would dominate the headlines.
examples.cn: 倘若公共讨论真正坦率，就不会有那么多谣言占据头条。

exercises.q: If I ______ a million yuan, I would buy a house for my parents.
If I ______ (be) a bird, I would fly over the river.
“If I were you, I will wait.” 是正确的第二类条件句。
改写：I don't have a dog, so I don't walk it in the park. → If ...
exercises.answer: If I had a dog, I would walk it in the park.

exercises.q: 改错：If I was you, I would keep trying.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would keep trying.

exercises.q: If she lived near school, she ______ walk there.
If I ______ you, I would say sorry.
exercises.explain: If I were you 是固定说法。

Choose the correct sentence.

If I have a camera, I would take photos.
If I had a camera, I will take photos.
If I would have a camera, I would take photos.

If we ______ (live) by the sea, we would walk on the beach after dinner.

exercises.answer: If I were tall, I would play basketball well.

exercises.q: 把 will 改成虚拟：If it rains, we will stay home.
exercises.answer: If it rained, we would stay home.

exercises.q: 改错：If she had time, she will join us.
exercises.answer: If she had time, she would join us.

If I ______ (be) more sociable, I would make friends faster.
could 可以代替 would，表示“能够”。
exercises.explain: If I had a key, I could open the door。

exercises.q: 改写：He is not extroverted, so he doesn't start small talk. → If ...
exercises.answer: If he were extroverted, he would start small talk.

exercises.q: 改错：If I were you, I will not judge a book by its cover.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would not judge a book by its cover.

exercises.q: If I were frank with him, he ______ hurt for a moment.
If the club ______ a small talk session, shy members would open up faster.
If I ______ you, I would not judge a book by its cover.
They could lend a hand if they ______ the time.
exercises.explain: could 主句 + 过去时从句。

exercises.q: If they established ties with the new class, they ______ (exchange) ideas more often.
If he ______ (not dominate) the discussion, others would speak.
改写：They don't pay attention to slips of the tongue, so they laugh too quickly. → If ...
exercises.answer: If they paid attention to slips of the tongue, they would not laugh so quickly.

exercises.q: 用 If I were you 改写：You should open up to a trusted friend.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would open up to a trusted friend.

exercises.q: 改错：If he would be frank, we would trust him more.
exercises.answer: If he were frank, we would trust him more.
exercises.explain: 从句用 were，不用 would be。

exercises.q: 第二类从句必须使用过去完成时。
If the speaker ______ less, the audience would stay focused.
If I ______ (be) more certain of my values, other voices would not drown me out.
If I were to refuse 表示将来不太可能去拒绝，或仅仅是假想。
改写：I am not confident, so I don't take the mock interview. → If ...
exercises.answer: If I were confident, I would take the mock interview.

exercises.q: 改错：If I were you, I will think twice.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would think twice.

exercises.q: If I were in her position, I ______ the challenge rather than avoid it.
If first impressions ______ always accurate, interviews would be unnecessary.
People might show more support if they ______ the risks involved.
If he didn't insist on winning every argument, friends ______ more relaxed.
If they ______ (not underestimate) her, they would offer a real opportunity.
If the tactic ______ (work), we would keep it. (假设它现在并不奏效)
改写：They don't keep in mind the other person's feelings, so they sound rude. → If ...
exercises.answer: If they kept in mind the other person's feelings, they would not sound rude.

exercises.q: 用 were to 改写：If I asked her tomorrow, she would probably refuse.
exercises.answer: If I were to ask her tomorrow, she would probably refuse.

exercises.q: 改错：If she would have more self-esteem, she would speak up.
exercises.answer: If she had more self-esteem, she would speak up.

exercises.q: 第二类主句不能用 might。
If the committee ______ less prejudice, the candidate would have a fairer hearing.
exercises.explain: 第二类用过去时，不是过去完成。

exercises.q: If public figures ______ (be) more faithful to facts, rumours would spread less.
If I was 在口语里常见，但正式书面语更推荐 If I were。
改写：We don't have enough time, so we don't conduct a proper survey. → If ...
exercises.answer: If we had enough time, we would conduct a proper survey.

exercises.q: 改错：If I were you, I will not interrupt others' conversations.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would not interrupt others' conversations.

exercises.q: If I were in charge, the discussion ______ by one person.
If the two sides ______ roles for a week, empathy might increase.
What would happen if the stereotype ______ unchallenged?
If she were to reveal too much too soon, listeners ______ uncomfortable.
If I ______ (confront) the problem now, I would sleep better tonight. (were to)
They might open up if we ______ (not judge) them so quickly.
用 were to 改写：If the firm revealed the data, customers would panic.
exercises.answer: If the firm were to reveal the data, customers would panic.

exercises.q: 改写：I don't know her counterpart, so I cannot introduce them. → If ...
exercises.answer: If I knew her counterpart, I could introduce them.

exercises.q: 改错：If they would pay attention to tone, fewer conflicts would start.
exercises.answer: If they paid attention to tone, fewer conflicts would start.

exercises.q: 第二类不能使用被动语态。
exercises.explain: would be done 完全可以。

exercises.q: If journalists ______ less on first impressions, reports would be fairer.
If the platform ______ (not isolate) minority voices, debate would be richer.
混合虚拟 If I had studied, I would be confident now 把过去条件与现在结果结合。
exercises.explain: 这是高中拓展，不是标准第二类，但相关。

exercises.q: 改写：The audience is isolated, so the speaker cannot connect with them. → If ...
exercises.answer: If the audience were not isolated, the speaker could connect with them.

exercises.q: 改错：If the candidate would be more prepared, the panel would be impressed.
exercises.answer: If the candidate were more prepared, the panel would be impressed.

exercises.q: If the law were strictly enforced, discrimination ______ so easily.
If I were to paraphrase his claim without sarcasm, he ______ more willing to listen.
Communities would be healthier if lonely people ______ on a regular basis.
If she didn't let one tragedy ______ her, she would still connect with friends.
If I ______ (be) to start the project again, I would map the risks first.
Voters might show more empathy if stories ______ (not exaggerate) suffering.
用 were to 改写：If the company cut down the price, profits might still rise.
exercises.answer: If the company were to cut down the price, profits might still rise.

exercises.q: 改写：I don't have insight into their motives, so I won't confront them yet. → If ...
exercises.answer: If I had insight into their motives, I would confront them.

exercises.q: 改错：If we analysed our weaknesses, we will not keep exaggerating our strengths.
exercises.answer: If we analysed our weaknesses, we would not keep exaggerating our strengths.

exercises.q: 第二类的过去时表示动作发生在昨天。
exercises.explain: 过去时在这里是虚拟标记，不是过去时间。

exercises.q: If civic education ______ empathy as a skill, public debate would be less tribal.
If attention ______ (not be) so fragmented, deep reading would still be common.
倒装 Were the plan realistic, we would fund it 等于 If the plan were realistic...。
改写倒装：If the platform were transparent, users would trust the recommendation less blindly.
exercises.answer: Were the platform transparent, users would trust the recommendation less blindly.

exercises.q: 改错：If extreme sports were safer, more schools will introduce them.
exercises.answer: If extreme sports were safer, more schools would introduce them.

exercises.q: If the algorithm were not optimised for outrage, users ______ longer on nuanced arguments.
Were the evidence ______, the journal would retract the paper.
exercises.explain: Were the evidence unreliable = If the evidence were unreliable。

exercises.q: If leaders were to ______ the inconvenience of regulation, fewer harms would scale.
Inequality would narrow if opportunity ______ more evenly.
Were I ______ (ask) to rank the factors, I would put trust first.
If institutions ______ (confront) bias instead of denying it, legitimacy would rise.
学术写作应避免第二类，因为“虚拟”不够客观。
exercises.explain: 讨论反事实政策时第二类很常见。

exercises.q: 用 were to 改写：If governments banned the sport, passion would simply move elsewhere.
exercises.answer: If governments were to ban the sport, passion would simply move elsewhere.

exercises.q: 改写：We lack reliable data, so we cannot pin down the death rate. → If ...
exercises.answer: If we had reliable data, we could pin down the death rate.

exercises.q: 改错：Were the coach more experienced, the starter can attempt the jump.
exercises.answer: Were the coach more experienced, the starter could attempt the jump.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语及相关形式（It is + adj. + to do / 动名词复合结构）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject and related forms
grammar.usage:
动名词（V-ing）可作主语，表示一种活动或习惯，谓语用单数。
Knowing yourself is crucial.
否定：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood.
可用 it 作形式主语：It is crucial to know yourself.（不定式更常见）
初中：不要把动名词主语当成进行时；谓语用 is/was/helps，不用 are。
高中：复合结构 Tom's/Tom being late 作主语；动名词与不定式作主语的细微差别（动名词偏泛指习惯，不定式偏具体/将来）；There is no + doing；worth doing。
forms: V-ing + 单数谓语
Not + V-ing + 单数谓语
It's + adj. + (for sb) + to do（近义转换）
所有格/宾格 + V-ing（复合结构）
There is no + V-ing / be worth + V-ing
notes: 动名词主语视为单数。
不要写成 To knowing 或 Know yourself is...（祈使不能直接当主语）。
否定是 Not doing，不是 Don't doing。
It's no use + doing；be busy doing。
动名词作主语 ≠ 现在进行时。

examples.en: Reading every night helps me sleep.
examples.cn: 每晚阅读帮助我入睡。

examples.en: Helping others makes us happier.
examples.cn: 帮助别人让我们更快乐。

examples.en: Knowing yourself without judgement is crucial for defining yourself.
examples.cn: 不加评判地了解自己，对定义自己至关重要。

examples.en: Interrupting others constantly ruins a conversation.
examples.cn: 不断打断别人会毁掉谈话。

examples.en: Building empathy takes more than a single compliment.
examples.cn: 建立共情需要的不只是一句恭维。

examples.en: Reducing fragmented attention is essential for deep work.
examples.cn: 减少碎片化注意力对深度工作至关重要。

exercises.q: ______ breakfast is important.
Collecting stamps ______ (be) fun.
“Read books is fun.” 是正确的。
改写：If you exercise, you will feel better. → 动名词作主语。
exercises.answer: Exercising makes you feel better. / Exercising will make you feel better.

exercises.q: 改错：To reading in bed is relaxing.
Playing games ______ him happy.
Choose the correct sentence.
______ late is impolite.
Walking after dinner ______ me relax.
Not ______ (do) homework will get you in trouble.
______ (Listen) to music helps her focus.
改为否定主语：Getting up late is a bad habit.
exercises.answer: Not getting up late is a good habit. / Getting up late is not a good habit.
exercises.explain: 两种否定，推荐 Not getting up late is a good idea. 题意：Not getting up late is good. 标准：Getting up late is not a good habit.

exercises.q: 用 It's 改写：Learning a language is useful.
exercises.answer: It is useful to learn a language.

exercises.q: 改错：Knowing English help you travel.
动名词作主语时谓语常用复数。
______ a hand is always welcome.
Opening up to a friend ______ (require) trust.
“Let's helping” 是动名词作主语。
改写：If you listen carefully, you learn more.
exercises.answer: Listening carefully helps you learn more.

exercises.q: 改错：Not pay attention is risky.
Not ______ attention causes mistakes.
______ twice saves you trouble.
Helping others ______ never a waste of time.
Which is correct?
options: To keeping a promise builds trust.

exercises.q: Not ______ (interrupt) is a basic rule.
______ (Paraphrase) can prevent misunderstanding.
It's no use crying 中 crying 是动名词。
否定主语：Paying attention is optional. → 强调必须注意。
exercises.answer: Not paying attention is dangerous. / Paying attention is not optional.

exercises.q: It's no use 改写：Don't wait without acting.
exercises.answer: It's no use waiting without acting.

exercises.q: 改错：To interrupting others is rude.
Not ______ your values makes identity unstable.
Pinning down a direction ______ (help) later life.
动名词作主语时可以随意改成进行时 you are knowing。
exercises.explain: know 一般不用进行时，且结构不同。

exercises.q: 用 It's 改写：Gaining insight into identity takes patience.
exercises.answer: It takes patience to gain insight into identity.

exercises.q: 改错：Define yourself well is not easy.
exercises.answer: Defining yourself well is not easy.

exercises.q: ______ from struggles builds insight.
Which is NOT a gerund subject?
options: Try to know yourself from intimate relationships.
Comparing yourself with others can hurt.
Getting rid of negative talk helps.
exercises.answer: Try to know yourself from intimate relationships.

exercises.q: ______ out to mentors requires a little bravery.
Underestimating yourself ______ progress.
Not ______ (get) rid of negative thoughts drowns out your voice.
______ (Adopt) a realistic pace is necessary.
It's crucial to know yourself 与 Knowing yourself is crucial 近义。
否定：Comparing yourself with others is helpful. → 相反观点。
exercises.answer: Comparing yourself with others is not helpful. / Not comparing yourself with others is wiser.

exercises.q: 复合结构：Tom is late. This annoyed us. → Tom's ...
改错：Not get rid of fear keeps you stuck.
exercises.answer: Not getting rid of fear keeps you stuck.

exercises.q: Not ______ a book by its cover prevents prejudice.
Keeping in mind the context ______ (prevent) slips of the tongue from snowballing.
Tom being late 在正式语里不如 Tom's being late 稳妥。
复合：The partner was frank. That surprised us.
exercises.answer: The partner's being frank surprised us.

grammar.key: First Conditional (if + present simple, future simple/imperative) / 第一类条件句 (if + 一般现在时，一般将来时/祈使句)
grammar.title: 第一类条件句（If + 现在，主句 will/情态/祈使）及 unless / as long as
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional and related real conditions
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句谈论真实、将来很可能发生的情况。
结构：If + 一般现在时, 主句用 will / can / must / 祈使句。
否定：If it doesn't rain, we will go out. 或 Unless it rains, we will go out.
疑问：What will you do if you miss the bus?
初中：if 从句不用 will；if 在句首时用逗号。
高中拓展：unless = if not；as long as / provided that 表示只要；even if 表示即使（让步，不是纯条件）；will 偶尔出现在 if 从句中表示“愿意”（If you will wait a moment）。不要把 if 从句的 will 当成将来时标记。
forms: If + S + 现在时, S + will/can/must + V
If + S + 现在时, 祈使句
Unless + S + 现在时, S + will + V  (= If ... not)
As long as / Provided that + 现在时, 主句将来
What will you do if ...?
notes: if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will（愿意义除外）。
unless 已经含否定，不要再加 not。
主句可以是祈使句或情态动词，不一定是 will。
even if 是让步，不等于 if。
if 在句中时，通常不用逗号。

grammar.key: Comparative Structure 'the more..., the more...' / 比较结构 'the more..., the more...'
grammar.title: “越……越……”比较结构（the + comparative）及相关形式
grammar.titleEn: The + comparative..., the + comparative... (and related forms)
grammar.usage:
本结构表示两个变化按比例同时发生：前半句是条件或程度，后半句是结果。核心公式是 The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语。比较级可以是 -er（harder, earlier）或 more/less + 形容词/副词（more carefully, less nervous）。
肯定：The more you practise, the more fluent you become.
否定结果：The later you start, the less time you will have.
疑问不常用整句提问，但可以就其中一部分设空。
初中重点：两个 the 都不能丢，比较级不能写成原级或最高级；主句常用一般现在或 will。
高中拓展：可省略部分谓语（The sooner, the better.）；可与 the less、the fewer 对照；注意 more and more 是“越来越……”（单一趋势），不要和“越A越B”混用；书面语中后半句可倒装（the greater will be the reward）。
forms: The + 比较级 + S + V, the + 比较级 + S + V
The more/less + adj./n. + S + V, the more/less ...
The sooner / The earlier ..., the better ...
省略式：The sooner, the better.
对比：more and more + adj. = 越来越……（只有一个变化）
notes: 两个分句前面都要有 the，漏掉 the 是最常见错误。
必须用比较级，不能用 highest / most interesting 这种最高级。
the more + 不可数名词 / the more + 复数名词；the fewer 只接可数复数。
高中不要把 more and more 与 the more..., the more... 当成同一句型。
If 条件句表示“如果发生A就B”，本结构强调“A的程度越高，B的程度也越高”。

exercises.q: 改写：If a speaker is more frank, listeners feel more respected.

exercises.answer: The more precisely we pin the problem down, the less time we waste.

exercises.answer: The more you expose yourself to English, the better your listening will be.

exercises.q: The greater the empathy you show, the ______ the other person is to open up.

exercises.q: The higher the stakes, the ______ (careful) the wording must be.

exercises.q: The more ______ a research question is defined, the more manageable the project becomes.

exercises.q: The fewer assumptions we make, ______ our argument will stand.
______ the delay, the more expensive the repair will be.

exercises.answer: The more you analyse the strengths, the clearer the plan becomes.

used only after branded exam prompts
exercises.answer: acceptable in headings or comments, but full clauses are preferred in arguments

exercises.q: The broader the social setting you can interact with, the ______ (adapt) you become. (more + adj.)

exercises.explain: 后半句 be 动词可提前。

exercises.q: 改错：The more fragmented is our attention, the hard it is to complete deep work.
exercises.answer: The more fragmented our attention is, the harder it is to complete deep work.
exercises.explain: 前半句恢复 SV 语序；hard → harder。

exercises.q: The more ______ a public statement is, the more room it leaves for misinterpretation.
exercises.explain: statement 用形容词 ambiguous 修饰。

exercises.q: ______ the regulation, the greater the incentive for companies to look for loopholes.
The less one is defined by others' expectations, ______ one can act from personal values.
exercises.explain: 修饰 act 用副词 freely。

exercises.q: Which sentence is the most formal and accurate?

exercises.explain: 正式书面语保持 the + 比较级 成对出现。

exercises.q: The more rigorously a hypothesis is tested, the ______ (credible) the findings become.
The fewer ethical shortcuts a team takes, the ______ (sustainable) its success is.
高中书面语里必须在题干中写考试品牌才能使用该结构。
exercises.explain: 这是普通英语结构，与某次考试名称无关。

exercises.q: 改写：If digital platforms harvest more personal data, users become more vulnerable.
exercises.answer: The more personal data digital platforms harvest, the more vulnerable users become.

exercises.q: 改写：If a mentor's guidance is more specific, a student realises more of his or her potential.
exercises.answer: The more specific a mentor's guidance is, the more of his or her potential a student realises.

exercises.answer: The more you insist on your first impression, the more prejudice you reinforce.

grammar.key: 'As long as' for Condition / 'As long as' 表示条件
grammar.title: 第一类条件句（If + 现在，主句 will/情态/祈使）及 unless / as long as
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional and related real conditions
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句谈论真实、将来很可能发生的情况。
结构：If + 一般现在时, 主句用 will / can / must / 祈使句。
否定：If it doesn't rain, we will go out. 或 Unless it rains, we will go out.
疑问：What will you do if you miss the bus?
初中：if 从句不用 will；if 在句首时用逗号。
高中拓展：unless = if not；as long as / provided that 表示只要；even if 表示即使（让步，不是纯条件）；will 偶尔出现在 if 从句中表示“愿意”（If you will wait a moment）。不要把 if 从句的 will 当成将来时标记。
forms: If + S + 现在时, S + will/can/must + V
If + S + 现在时, 祈使句
Unless + S + 现在时, S + will + V  (= If ... not)
As long as / Provided that + 现在时, 主句将来
What will you do if ...?
notes: if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will（愿意义除外）。
unless 已经含否定，不要再加 not。
主句可以是祈使句或情态动词，不一定是 will。
even if 是让步，不等于 if。
if 在句中时，通常不用逗号。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay in the library.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在图书馆。

examples.en: If you feel uncertain, ask your mentor for a clear direction.
examples.cn: 如果你感到不确定，就向导师请教一个明确的方向。

examples.en: If you don't get rid of those negative thoughts, they will drown out your own voice.
examples.cn: 如果你不摆脱那些消极想法，它们就会淹没你自己的声音。

examples.en: Unless you pin down your core values, your identity will remain unstable.
examples.cn: 除非你确定自己的核心价值观，否则你的认同会一直不稳定。

examples.en: As long as the evidence is reliable, the committee will adopt the new procedure.
examples.cn: 只要证据可靠，委员会就会采用新程序。

examples.en: If the platform continues to mislead users, regulators will have no choice but to intervene.
examples.cn: 如果该平台继续误导用户，监管部门将别无选择，只能介入。

exercises.q: If it ______ sunny, we will fly kites in the park.
If Lucy ______ (finish) her homework, she will watch a film.
“If you see Mia, please tell her the news.” 正确。
改写：It may rain. Then we will take an umbrella. → 用 If 连成一句。
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will take an umbrella.

exercises.q: 改错：If Jack play football, he will be happy.
exercises.answer: If Jack plays football, he will be happy.

exercises.q: We ______ at home if it snows tomorrow.
If you are hungry, ______ a sandwich.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: If Tom studies hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom will study hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom study hard, he will pass the test.
If Tom studies hard, he pass the test.
exercises.answer: If Tom studies hard, he will pass the test.

exercises.q: If they ______ the map, they will find the museum.
If you don't hurry, you ______ (be) late.
If the shop is closed, we ______ (go) tomorrow.
If 在句首时，常用逗号把从句和主句分开。
改写：Finish your vegetables, and you can have ice cream. → 用 If。
exercises.answer: If you finish your vegetables, you can have ice cream.

exercises.q: 把主句改成祈使句：If you feel cold, you will put on a coat.
exercises.answer: If you feel cold, put on a coat.

exercises.q: 改错：If it not rain, we will go cycling.
exercises.answer: If it does not rain, we will go cycling.

exercises.q: You can borrow my notes if you ______ them back tomorrow.
exercises.explain: if 在句中同样用现在时。

exercises.q: If we ______ (not hurry), the train will leave.
主句用 can 仍然属于第一类条件句。
exercises.explain: 真实条件的主句不限于 will。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you don't wear a helmet, you will not ride.
exercises.answer: Unless you wear a helmet, you will not ride. / You will not ride unless you wear a helmet.

exercises.q: 改错：If he don't practise, he will not improve.
exercises.answer: If he doesn't practise, he will not improve.

exercises.q: If the museum is crowded, we ______ another day.
______ you need help, send me a message.

If the weather ______ (get) worse, the match will be cancelled.
You will feel better if you ______ (get) rid of that worry.
改写：Study this map, and you will find the exit. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you study this map, you will find the exit.

exercises.q: 把 if 从句移到句尾：If you pin the time down, we can book tickets.
exercises.answer: We can book tickets if you pin the time down.
exercises.explain: 从句在后通常不加逗号。

exercises.q: 改错：Unless you don't save the file, you will lose it.
exercises.answer: Unless you save the file, you will lose it.

exercises.q: if 从句永远不能放在主句后面。
You will gain more insight if you ______ with people from different social settings.
If you ______ (not get) rid of those fears, they will drown out your ideas.
If + 现在完成时 有时可以表示“如果到那时已经……”。
exercises.explain: If you have finished, we can leave。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you are not certain of the facts, don't post the comment.
exercises.answer: Unless you are certain of the facts, don't post the comment.

exercises.q: 改错：If no one but you can defines yourself, you will still need mentors.
exercises.answer: If no one but you can define yourself, you will still need mentors.

exercises.q: If the direction is still vague, ______ your mentor.
______ you compare yourself with others all the time, you will underestimate your own progress.
If she ______ her core values, her choices will be more stable.
The plan will work if everyone ______ action in time.
If the process ______ (be) slow, keep going at a steady pace.
You will recognise the problem if you ______ (compare) the two reports.
改写：Fail to take action, and the chance will disappear. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you fail to take action, the chance will disappear.

exercises.q: 用 as long as 改写：If you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.answer: As long as you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.explain: as long as 强调前提持续。

exercises.q: 改错：If she don't identify the problem, she will repeat it.
exercises.answer: If she doesn't identify the problem, she will repeat it.

exercises.q: if 从句里用现在进行时一律错误。
exercises.explain: If you are still waiting 可以用进行时描述当前状况。

exercises.q: The intern will be able to join the project if she ______ the safety training.

exercises.answer: Unless the application is complete, they will not register you.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless you don't log on to the platform, you cannot download the file.
exercises.answer: Unless you log on to the platform, you cannot download the file.

exercises.q: ______ the data remain reliable, we will adopt the model.
If you will ______ a seat for a moment, I will print the form.
exercises.explain: 此处 will 表愿意，后接原形。

exercises.q: Unless the noise ______, we cannot continue the recording.
If students ______ already submitted the draft, they can start revising.
exercises.explain: If + 现在完成时表示到目前已完成。

exercises.q: You will underestimate the risk if you ______ (ignore) the minority report.

第一类条件句不能使用情态动词 can。
用 provided that 改写：If the insurance is valid, the refund will be processed.
exercises.answer: Provided that the insurance is valid, the refund will be processed.

exercises.q: 改写：Should you need a receipt, the shop will print one. → 用 If。
exercises.answer: If you need a receipt, the shop will print one. / If you should need a receipt, the shop will print one.

exercises.q: 改错：If she have already paid, the system will send a refund.
exercises.answer: If she has already paid, the system will send a refund.

exercises.q: 用 inverted should 改写：If you need further documents, write to the office.
exercises.answer: Should you need further documents, write to the office.

exercises.q: 改错：If the audience are isolated, the speaker will change the activity.
exercises.answer: If the audience is isolated, the speaker will change the activity.

exercises.q: ______ the contract is signed this week, construction can begin in March.
exercises.explain: so long as = as long as。

If anything ______, contact the instructor immediately.
Which is NOT a first conditional?

If the server crashes, we will restore the backup.
If you have any questions, email me.
If prices rise, demand will fall.
exercises.answer: If I were you, I would wait.

exercises.q: The reform will work if the majority ______ (be) willing to compromise.
______ the evidence remains fragmented, we will not publish. (If)

用 unless 改写：If the blogger does not correct the claim, readers will be misled.
exercises.answer: Unless the blogger corrects the claim, readers will be misled.

exercises.q: 用 as long as 改写：If you stay in touch with your mentors, your network will grow.
exercises.answer: As long as you stay in touch with your mentors, your network will grow.

exercises.answer: Provided that you pay in advance, the reservation will be kept.

exercises.q: Social trust will erode if institutions ______ accountability.

exercises.q: 用 inverted should 改写：If the experiment fail, we will publish the negative result anyway.
exercises.answer: Should the experiment fail, we will publish the negative result anyway.

exercises.answer: If a passion is unique, it will not automatically lead to success. / If a passion is unique, it does not automatically lead to success.
exercises.explain: 真实条件不要混用 would；同时注意逻辑。推荐：If a passion is unique, it will not automatically lead to success.

exercises.q: ______ funding remain stable, the longitudinal study can run for another decade.
exercises.explain: Should funding remain = If funding should remain。

exercises.q: If critics are right, the so-called win-win pattern ______ a marketing slogan.
exercises.explain: 说话人把批评当真，用真实条件。

exercises.q: The proposal will be adopted if, and only if, the environmental review ______.
exercises.explain: if and only if 仍用现在时。

exercises.q: Which sentence is stylistically most academic?

If we will increase the sample, findings are more generalisable.

If the sample size increased, findings will be more generalisable.

exercises.q: The reform will stall unless both parties ______ (be) willing to compromise.
______ the hypothesis hold, further tests will be funded. (Should)
if 从句中用 will 表纯粹将来，在正式英语里通常被视为错误。
用 unless 改写：If we do not confront the stereotype, it will keep shaping first impressions.
exercises.answer: Unless we confront the stereotype, it will keep shaping first impressions.

exercises.q: 用 provided that 改写：If privacy is protected, the app can remain in use.
exercises.answer: Provided that privacy is protected, the app can remain in use.

exercises.q: 改错：Unless governments don't regulate the platform, users will remain vulnerable.
exercises.answer: Unless governments regulate the platform, users will remain vulnerable.

grammar.key: Comparative Structure: The more... the more... / 越...越...结构
grammar.title: “越……越……”比较结构（the + comparative）及相关形式
grammar.titleEn: The + comparative..., the + comparative... (and related forms)
grammar.usage:
本结构表示两个变化按比例同时发生：前半句是条件或程度，后半句是结果。核心公式是 The + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语, the + 比较级 + 主语 + 谓语。比较级可以是 -er（harder, earlier）或 more/less + 形容词/副词（more carefully, less nervous）。
肯定：The more you practise, the more fluent you become.
否定结果：The later you start, the less time you will have.
疑问不常用整句提问，但可以就其中一部分设空。
初中重点：两个 the 都不能丢，比较级不能写成原级或最高级；主句常用一般现在或 will。
高中拓展：可省略部分谓语（The sooner, the better.）；可与 the less、the fewer 对照；注意 more and more 是“越来越……”（单一趋势），不要和“越A越B”混用；书面语中后半句可倒装（the greater will be the reward）。
forms: The + 比较级 + S + V, the + 比较级 + S + V
The more/less + adj./n. + S + V, the more/less ...
The sooner / The earlier ..., the better ...
省略式：The sooner, the better.
对比：more and more + adj. = 越来越……（只有一个变化）
notes: 两个分句前面都要有 the，漏掉 the 是最常见错误。
必须用比较级，不能用 highest / most interesting 这种最高级。
the more + 不可数名词 / the more + 复数名词；the fewer 只接可数复数。
高中不要把 more and more 与 the more..., the more... 当成同一句型。
If 条件句表示“如果发生A就B”，本结构强调“A的程度越高，B的程度也越高”。

grammar.title: 现在完成时（经历/持续）及 since / for / already / yet / have been able to
grammar.titleEn: Present perfect for life experience and unfinished time
grammar.usage:
现在完成时：have/has + 过去分词，把过去发生的事与现在联系起来。
用法一：到现在为止的经历（ever / never / before）。
用法二：从过去持续到现在（since + 点时间 / for + 一段时间）。
否定：have/has not；疑问：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词。
初中：since 与 for 不要混；不规则动词用过去分词，不是过去式。
高中：现在完成进行时 have been doing 强调不间断；短暂动词（go/buy）在肯定句中不宜与 for 连用表示持续；对比一般过去时（有明确过去时间状语 yesterday/in 2019 时用过去时）。already 多用于肯定，yet 多用于否定/疑问。
forms: S + have/has + V-ed (+ already/before)
Have/Has + S + V-ed ... yet?
S + have/has + V-ed + since + 时间点
S + have/has + V-ed + for + 时段
have been doing（完成进行） / have been able to
notes: since 接时间点，for 接一段时间。
有明确过去时间（yesterday）时用一般过去时，不用现在完成时。
第三人称单数用 has，不是 have。
过去分词不要写成过去式（has wrote → has written）。
already 通常不与否定连用，否定用 yet。

grammar.key: Adverbial Clause of Condition with 'as long as' / 由 'as long as' 引导的条件状语从句
grammar.title: 第一类条件句（If + 现在，主句 will/情态/祈使）及 unless / as long as
grammar.titleEn: First Conditional and related real conditions
grammar.usage:
第一类条件句谈论真实、将来很可能发生的情况。
结构：If + 一般现在时, 主句用 will / can / must / 祈使句。
否定：If it doesn't rain, we will go out. 或 Unless it rains, we will go out.
疑问：What will you do if you miss the bus?
初中：if 从句不用 will；if 在句首时用逗号。
高中拓展：unless = if not；as long as / provided that 表示只要；even if 表示即使（让步，不是纯条件）；will 偶尔出现在 if 从句中表示“愿意”（If you will wait a moment）。不要把 if 从句的 will 当成将来时标记。
forms: If + S + 现在时, S + will/can/must + V
If + S + 现在时, 祈使句
Unless + S + 现在时, S + will + V  (= If ... not)
As long as / Provided that + 现在时, 主句将来
What will you do if ...?
notes: if 从句用一般现在时，不用 will（愿意义除外）。
unless 已经含否定，不要再加 not。
主句可以是祈使句或情态动词，不一定是 will。
even if 是让步，不等于 if。
if 在句中时，通常不用逗号。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay in the library.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在图书馆。

examples.en: If you feel uncertain, ask your mentor for a clear direction.
examples.cn: 如果你感到不确定，就向导师请教一个明确的方向。

examples.en: If you don't get rid of those negative thoughts, they will drown out your own voice.
examples.cn: 如果你不摆脱那些消极想法，它们就会淹没你自己的声音。

examples.en: Unless you pin down your core values, your identity will remain unstable.
examples.cn: 除非你确定自己的核心价值观，否则你的认同会一直不稳定。

examples.en: As long as the evidence is reliable, the committee will adopt the new procedure.
examples.cn: 只要证据可靠，委员会就会采用新程序。

examples.en: If the platform continues to mislead users, regulators will have no choice but to intervene.
examples.cn: 如果该平台继续误导用户，监管部门将别无选择，只能介入。

exercises.answer: If you feel cold, put on a coat.

exercises.answer: If she arrives at 8, we will wait.

exercises.explain: 真实条件的主句不限于 will。

exercises.q: 改错：Unless you don't save the file, you will lose it.
exercises.answer: Unless you save the file, you will lose it.

options: If it doesn't work, try another way.
If it will not work, try another way.
If it not work, try another way.
If it don't work, try another way.
exercises.answer: If it doesn't work, try another way.

exercises.q: If the weather ______ (get) worse, the match will be cancelled.

“If you will help me, I will finish sooner.” 里的 will 可以表示“愿意”。
exercises.explain: will 表意愿时可以出现在 if 从句中。

exercises.q: 改写：Study this map, and you will find the exit. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you study this map, you will find the exit.

exercises.q: 把 if 从句移到句尾：If you pin the time down, we can book tickets.

exercises.q: 改错：If you will feel tired, drink some water.
exercises.answer: If you feel tired, drink some water.

exercises.q: If the direction is still vague, ______ your mentor.

exercises.explain: If you have finished, we can leave。

exercises.q: 用 unless 改写：If you are not certain of the facts, don't post the comment.
exercises.answer: Unless you are certain of the facts, don't post the comment.

exercises.q: 改错：If she don't identify the problem, she will repeat it.
exercises.answer: If she doesn't identify the problem, she will repeat it.

exercises.q: ______ you compare yourself with others all the time, you will underestimate your own progress.

The plan will work if everyone ______ action in time.
Which is closest in meaning to “If you don't figure it out, ask”?
options: Unless you figure it out, ask.
If you figure it out, ask.
Although you figure it out, ask.
If you will not figure it out, you asked.
exercises.answer: Unless you figure it out, ask.

exercises.q: If the process ______ (be) slow, keep going at a steady pace.

exercises.explain: 真实条件主句可以是祈使。

exercises.q: 改写：Fail to take action, and the chance will disappear. → If ...
exercises.answer: If you fail to take action, the chance will disappear.

exercises.q: 用 as long as 改写：If you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.answer: As long as you keep learning from mistakes, you will grow.
exercises.explain: as long as 强调前提持续。

exercises.q: 改错：If you will tend to compare yourself with others, you will feel negative.
exercises.answer: If you tend to compare yourself with others, you will feel negative.

exercises.q: ______ the data remain reliable, we will adopt the model.

用 unless 改写：If the application is not complete, they will not register you.
exercises.answer: Unless the application is complete, they will not register you.

exercises.q: 改错：If she have already paid, the system will send a refund.
exercises.answer: If she has already paid, the system will send a refund.

exercises.q: If you will ______ a seat for a moment, I will print the form.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语及相关形式（It is + adj. + to do / 动名词复合结构）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as subject and related forms
grammar.usage:
动名词（V-ing）可作主语，表示一种活动或习惯，谓语用单数。
Knowing yourself is crucial.
否定：Not getting enough sleep affects your mood.
可用 it 作形式主语：It is crucial to know yourself.（不定式更常见）
初中：不要把动名词主语当成进行时；谓语用 is/was/helps，不用 are。
高中：复合结构 Tom's/Tom being late 作主语；动名词与不定式作主语的细微差别（动名词偏泛指习惯，不定式偏具体/将来）；There is no + doing；worth doing。
forms: V-ing + 单数谓语
Not + V-ing + 单数谓语
It's + adj. + (for sb) + to do（近义转换）
所有格/宾格 + V-ing（复合结构）
There is no + V-ing / be worth + V-ing
notes: 动名词主语视为单数。
不要写成 To knowing 或 Know yourself is...（祈使不能直接当主语）。
否定是 Not doing，不是 Don't doing。
It's no use + doing；be busy doing。
动名词作主语 ≠ 现在进行时。
